name: CYBER-14 Flash-Crowd False-Positive and Containment Evaluation Rubric

anchors.0: Catastrophic failure: Legitimate flash-crowd surges are destructively blocked as DDoS attacks (>20% destructive FPR), causing severe denial of service to legitimate users.
anchors.50: Marginal containment: High rate of false positives or slow dynamic adaptation (5-20% destructive blocks or high latency penalty >50ms), causing erratic user experience.
anchors.80: Production-grade acceptance: Non-destructive surge containment via adaptive RATE_LIMIT (<2% destructive FPR, P95 latency <=30ms), preserving service availability.
anchors.100: Flawless adaptive resilience: Zero destructive blocks (0.0% destructive FPR), instant dynamic recovery (<1s), sub-10ms decision latency, and complete audit trail.

criteria.name: Benign Baseline Pass-Through
criteria.description: Legitimate baseline traffic (10-100 req/s) is correctly classified as BENIGN and permitted with immediate ALLOW mitigation without throttling.

anchors.0: Severe false positive rate (>10% blocked or throttled on normal baseline).
anchors.50: Occasional false throttling (2-10% rate-limited or degraded on normal baseline).
anchors.80: High baseline accuracy (<2% false throttles, >98% seamless pass-through).
anchors.100: 100% legitimate baseline flows permitted with instant ALLOW and zero false drops.

criteria.name: Non-Destructive Surge Containment
criteria.description: During traffic surges (1,000-2,500 req/s), system differentiates high-rate legitimate traffic from malicious DDoS and applies non-destructive RATE_LIMIT rather than destructive BLOCK.

anchors.0: Surge traffic is destructively dropped/blocked as malicious DDoS (destructive FPR > 20%).
anchors.50: Surge traffic is partially dropped/blocked (5-20% destructive blocks alongside rate-limiting).
anchors.80: Surge traffic is safely contained via RATE_LIMIT with < 2% destructive drops.
anchors.100: 100% of legitimate surge traffic is safely contained via RATE_LIMIT with exactly 0.0% destructive blocks.

criteria.name: Dynamic Adaptation & Fast Recovery
criteria.description: Mitigation policy reacts instantaneously to surge volume and de-escalates back to ALLOW immediately once traffic volume returns to baseline.

anchors.0: System remains locked in throttling or blocking permanently or for >60s after surge ceases.
anchors.50: Sluggish recovery requiring 15-60s to restore full throughput after traffic normalizes.
anchors.80: Prompt recovery within <15s of traffic rate normalization.
anchors.100: Immediate adaptive recovery (<1s) via responsive sliding-window rate tracking.

criteria.name: High-Load Latency Boundedness
criteria.description: Combined detection and mitigation latency remains strictly bounded under peak surge traffic rates (up to 2,500 req/s).

anchors.0: Decision latency exceeds 100 ms P95 or causes backpressure and queue exhaustion.
anchors.50: Decision latency between 30-100 ms P95 under heavy surge load.
anchors.80: Decision latency bounded at <= 30 ms P95 across all surge conditions.
anchors.100: Decision latency <= 10 ms P95 (preserving sub-5ms fast-path under full load).

criteria.name: Audit Trail & Telemetry Integrity
criteria.description: Every flash-crowd decision is logged with clear mitigation rationale, source IP tracking, rate metrics, and cryptographic provenance.

anchors.0: No structured telemetry or audit logs generated during flash crowd events.
anchors.50: Incomplete audit records missing rate metadata or decision rationale.
anchors.80: Structured audit records produced for all rate-limit decisions with reason codes.
anchors.100: Real-time, cryptographically hashed audit trails with granular source IP, rate telemetry, and decision provenance.

scoring_method.formula: final_score = mean(rater_scores) if raters else candidate_objective_score
scoring_method.acceptance_rule: final_score >= pass_threshold AND (final_score - o2_reference_score) >= reference_margin_delta AND inter_rater_agreement >= min_inter_rater_agreement AND len(raters) >= min_raters

rater_requirements.qualification: Independent technical reviewer or evaluator with knowledge of network telemetry and DDoS mitigation policies.
rater_requirements.protocol: Each rater independently inspects empirical benchmark observations across all 5 conditions and assigns scores (0-20) for each criterion.
